jobs.title: Software Engineer 2 - AI Platform
jobs.notes: Standout of the run. Backend + AI platform simultaneously: agents, automated workflows, evaluation systems, data pipelines, model-quality feedback loops. Posting states '70-80% coding is non-negotiable' and targets engineers 'strong in backend engineering... excited to build in an AI-first platform environment'. Directly answers the 'AI that stalls at POC' concern.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III, Google Cloud
jobs.notes: Minimum 2 years, preferred 3 years DSA. Names Java/Kotlin and Python explicitly. Large-scale system design, distributed computing, data storage. Zero AI content - full marks under the equal-weighting rule. Single req covering both cities; you pick at application.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Data Catalog
jobs.notes: 'Intersection of platform infrastructure and AI'. Semantic layer making data 'discoverable, trustworthy, and actionable for both humans and AI' across millions of fields. Semantic search over enterprise-scale metadata maps directly onto the Deutsche Bank RAG chatbot work.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer (Java)
jobs.notes: IS&T Customer Systems. Supports 2.5B active devices; the AppleCare support platform handles 6 billion visits per year. Genuine high-throughput backend, matching your strongest measurable story. Java-first, aligns with the Spring Boot track.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III, AI/ML, Google Cloud
jobs.notes: Years requirement fits, but asks for 1 yr ML infrastructure (model deployment, evaluation, optimization) and lists TensorFlow / ML algorithms. That is model-side work, a documented weak area. Core GenAI/LLM concepts requirement is a strong match.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III, Infrastructure, Google Cloud
jobs.notes: Infrastructure-flavoured variant of the SWE III track. Not detail-fetched this run; verify the infra depth expectation before applying.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer - Agentic Systems (L6)
jobs.seniority: L6 Lead - two levels above band
jobs.notes: Agentic systems work in your home city is close to ideal on paper. Posted at L6 Lead, two levels above SDE-II. Sits in Business & Market Insights (analytics/insights org) with consulting-flavoured language. Expect the seniority bar to bite.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Initiative
jobs.notes: Same org as the two high-fit Rippling roles. One level up; worth a look if the SWE II applications progress well.

jobs.title: Software Engineer : Data & AI
jobs.notes: Not detail-fetched this run. Two near-identical postings (Bengaluru 4446061743, Hyderabad 4446080221) - likely one req across two sites.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Java
jobs.notes: Second Apple Java backend opening in Hyderabad. Not detail-fetched; compare scope against the Backend Engineer (Java) req before applying to both.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III, AI/ML
jobs.notes: Hyderabad variant of the AI/ML SWE III track. Same ML-infrastructure caveat as the Bengaluru posting.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Ingestion
jobs.notes: Lakeflow Connect team. Explicitly wants 'core Database internals' - incremental data capture, log parsing, extracting from OLTP with minimal production load. That is specialist DB-internals work and a genuine gap.

jobs.title: Generative AI Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.notes: Technology match is near-perfect: vector databases, RAG architectures, LangGraph, multi-agent patterns (ReAct, self-reflection), production AI from conception to launch. But requires 8 years and is a customer-embedded forward-deployed role, which brushes the recorded friction with client-facing delivery. Listed so you can make your own call.

jobs.title: Principal Applied AI App Engineer
jobs.notes: Pune and applied AI, but Principal level is far above SDE-II.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.notes: Part of the cluster of near-identical Bengaluru Staff postings previously flagged as a mass-posting pattern. Distribution signal only, not an accusation.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Infrastructure)
jobs.notes: Same Staff-level cluster. All Databricks India openings this run were Staff or Senior only.

observations: Mastercard's Pune volume is almost entirely above band - all ten postings were Senior, Lead, or Principal. The company with the best geography has the worst level fit.

The backend/AI equal-weighting change earned its keep immediately: Google Cloud SWE III and Apple Backend Engineer (Java) have no AI content at all and are two of the four best matches. The old 'no path for AI/LLM work to reach production' deal-breaker would have filtered both out.
All Databricks India openings this run were Staff or Senior only - no in-band roles exist there right now.
Google SWE III (L4) is the correct band for a 3-year SDE-II: minimum 2 years, preferred 3.
